about: One-frame request of the lockpicking system to turn the lockpicker towards the lock: created by bg3.exe+0x2E2AB60 (esv::lock::LockpickingSystem) and consumed by esv::steering::StateSystem::ProcessBeginRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x9BC9C0) as an esv::steering::Request, like esv::placement::SteeringRequestOneFrameComponent (same 48-byte shape, see layouts/alive). The first 16 bytes are ls::Variant<eoc::steering::ToDirection, ...> with the index byte at +0xC; this writer always uses alternative 1 (a target entity). Never seen alive. Registry total 48 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x2E2CA60 (AllocRaw 0x30) zeroes +0..+0xC. Writer bg3.exe+0x2E2AB60 lines 181-188: dwords +0/+4 = the target entity handle (the lock item). Toolkit ProcessBeginRequests: when byte +0xC == 1 it checks the 8-byte value at +0 of the request as an entity (type < 0x61, not null); with index 0 (eoc::steering::ToDirection) the same bytes hold a direction vec3 (placement request).
Third dword of the variant storage (z of a ToDirection vector); writer stores the dword 0 at +8.
Variant index: writer stores dword 1 at +0xC; Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x9BC060 / ProcessBeginRequests test whether the byte at +0xC of the request is 1 (entity) vs 0 (eoc::steering::ToDirection).
Upper bytes of the dword written with 1; not read.

Creator writes dword 0 at +0x10; Toolkit ProcessBeginRequests copies the dword at request+0x10 to +0x10 of the steering state, whose layout (layouts/alive/esv.steering.StateComponent) names it Flags (bits tested in ProcessSteering).
Not written by creator or writer.

Creator zeroes qwords +0x18/+0x20; writer lines 198-205 store two results of bg3.exe+0x4130D80 (Guid generation) at +0x18/+0x20 and copy them into the lockpicking state. Toolkit: WasAborted(..., (Guid*)(req+0x18)); esv::steering::LifetimeComponent.RequestId receives it.
Creator default 0x4B18967F (9999999.0); writer sets 1.0 (0x3F800000 at +0x28). Toolkit copies request+0x28 into esv::steering::LifetimeComponent.Lifetime (layouts/alive), which is counted down.

open_questions: +0..+0xB is a union (target entity or direction vector); the layout fixes the entity alternative, the only one this writer uses.
